name: Carbonda CFR707
why_interesting: Modern direct frame with wide clearance and current standards.
source_note: The current exact manufacturer page resolves construction, size-M frame reference weight and 700C maximum clearance. Fifty stiffness-specific areas found only owner ride context and generalized brand commentary, not a controlled exact-CFR707 stiffness result.

facts.frame_material: T700+T800 mixed-carbon one-piece monolith frame with EPS molding and full-Toray-carbon EPS fork
facts.frame_weight_basis: Manufacturer claim for size M, ±50 g, including alloy parts; paint and finish basis unpublished
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer maximum for 700C x 50 mm; 650B x 2.1 in is separately supported
facts.frame_stiffness_status: No controlled numeric or sufficiently specific independent exact-frame stiffness result found after 50 registered source areas
